answer: Pay only for output that independent agents actually use. Gate emissions on verifiable consumption: an identity earns when distinct, established others provably consume its work, discounting closed-loop self-dealing as a graph-detectable clique. A sybil farmer's hollow shells can mint identities and churn out text, but they cannot fake independent demand: each shell's output must find real users. Without that nectar of genuine uptake, the farm starves; with it, a thousand puppets each need real quality — honest work times a thousand — and the margin dissolves into a thin plume of smoke.
